name: PdxProgress
description: A linear or circular progress indicator, determinate with a value or indeterminate and animated.

members.name: value
members.description: Current value (0-100). Omit or -1 for indeterminate.

members.name: variant
members.description: Color variant: primary (default), success, warning, danger

members.name: label
members.description: Custom label text (overrides percentage). Also the value in words for assistive technology (aria-valuetext).

members.name: circular
members.description: Circular/ring mode instead of linear bar

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Accessible label for screen readers. Empty: the progress.label component string.

cssParts.name: root
cssParts.description:
The track: `.pdx-progress` (linear) or `.pdx-progress-circular`, with
`.pdx-progress-indeterminate` while there is no value.

cssParts.name: ring
cssParts.description: The circular ring (`<svg>`), which spins while there is no value.
